newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Virgin to fly Johannesburg - London route daily.
newsitem.headline: Virgin to fly Johannesburg - London route daily.

text.p: British airline Virgin Atlantic said on Friday it will be moving to daily flights between London and Johannesburg from July 15.
Virgin's London-Johannesburg service, launched in October, currently runs six flights a week.
The airline said in a statement issued in Johannesburg it was also launching a second daily flight between London and Los Angeles using its Airbus A340 aircraft.
"Virgin is now the second largest carrier of passengers and freight to and from the U.K.," it said.
The airline will take delivery of five new aircraft later this year, including two Boeing 747 400s and three Airbus A340s, bringing its fleet total to 20.
